headline: tofa servers, guided first-run setup, and single sign-on only
upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. Request ids are stored differently from this release on, so going back to an older version needs that backup

highlights.title: tofa
highlights.body: Tracearr now monitors tofa servers: live sessions, library, history import and tofa's built-in requests. Connect one by signing in to tofa, in setup or Settings → Servers, with no API key to paste. The owner and members can sign in with their tofa account too. tofa 0.13.3 or newer is needed.

highlights.title: First-run setup
highlights.body: A fresh install walks through signing in, connecting a server and importing history. Add Server offers the same import step later, and a new server starts its first library sync right away instead of waiting for the next scheduled one.

highlights.title: Single sign-on only
highlights.body: With OIDC configured, a new switch under Settings → Access → Sign-in makes your identity provider the only way admins and members sign in. The login page then shows just the single sign-on button; your own password, Plex and tofa sign-in stay available at /login?all for when the identity provider is down.

highlights.title: History imports
highlights.body: Imports start without waiting on the media server, and on a new server they wait for its first library sync. A failed Tautulli, Jellystat or Playback Reporting import now tries again on its own, while a rejected API key fails at once with the reason on the import card.

changes.text: new media server: tofa, with live sessions, library, history import and its built-in requests
connect a tofa server or sign in to Tracearr with a tofa account, with no API key to paste
option under Settings → Access → Sign-in to make single sign-on the only way admins and members sign in
Seerr requests for a title in no library show Seerr's poster when Seerr's image caching is on
first-run setup and Add Server walk through signing in, connecting a server and importing history
a new or re-added server starts its first library sync at once and fills in its growth history
history imports start right away, retry on their own up to 3 times, and no longer wait behind a growth backfill
people without a display name show their Tracearr username everywhere, the public API included
Live TV shows the program on air on every server, with its show, episode and art, and the channel under the title
refreshed theme and map colors with better light-mode contrast, and the Inter font no longer loads from Google
Jellyfin shows Direct Play, Direct Stream or Transcode by what the server does, music and remuxes included
episodes whose TVDB ids differ are no longer merged into one, even with the same IMDb id
people's pictures follow their media server accounts and update at sync, your own in the sidebar included
signing out of single sign-on returns to the login page; you stay signed in at the identity provider
a tofa server needs version 0.13.3 or newer
a person's name no longer follows a rename on the media server; set a display name to change it
